definitions.explanation: Neither necessary nor urgent. A four-character compound used in official requests to stay home or postpone plans, as in {不要不急|ふようふきゅう}の{外出|がいしゅつ} (going out for nonessential reasons).

examples.japanese: {不要不急|ふようふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えて→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不要不急|ふようふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けよう→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
examples.english: On typhoon days, let's avoid errands that can wait.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予想|よそう}される→予想する：06064_yosousuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不要不急|ふようふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧よう⟦{呼|よ}びかけた→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: With heavy snow forecast, the government asked people to avoid nonessential car trips.

notes:
Almost always before a noun as {不要不急|ふようふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜. It became an everyday word in 2020, when the government and local authorities repeatedly asked people to avoid {不要不急|ふようふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧ during the COVID-19 pandemic. It is also used in warnings before typhoons and heavy snow.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不要不急|ふようふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧: nonessential outings
- {不要不急|ふようふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{移動|いどう}→移動：01741_idou⟧: nonessential travel
- {不要不急|ふようふきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧: errands that can wait

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{不要|ふよう}→不要：02527_fuyou⟧ (unnecessary) + ⟦{不急|ふきゅう}→不急：16909_fukyuu⟧ (not urgent).
